title: Inbound Lead Slack Alert
summary: Score every form submission that hits a webhook and post it to Slack, flagging hot leads.
seoTitle: Auto-Score Inbound Leads and Alert Sales via Slack
answer: This template receives form submissions via an HMAC-authenticated webhook, scores each lead using an AI agent that evaluates name, email, company, and message content, then posts the lead to a designated Slack channel with a hot lead flag for scores of 7 or higher. Sales reps see every inbound lead instantly with AI-generated context about why it matters.

faq.q: How does the AI score leads?
faq.a: The AI agent reads the form fields (name, email, company, message) and assigns a score from 1 to 10 based on lead quality indicators like company domain, message intent, and fit signals. You can customize the scoring logic by editing the agent instructions.

faq.q: What form tools can trigger this workflow?
faq.a: Any form or CRM tool that sends HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks, including Typeform, Webflow, custom forms, or marketing automation platforms. You provide the shared HMAC secret and webhook URL.

faq.q: What appears in the Slack alert?
faq.a: The Slack message includes the lead's name, email, company, a hot lead emoji flag if the score is 7 or higher, the AI-generated score, and a one-line reason explaining why the lead is valuable or worth immediate follow-up.

faq.q: Can I route hot leads to a different Slack channel?
faq.a: Yes. You can modify the notify step to conditionally post to different channels based on the score, or add a second HTTP step that only runs when the score exceeds your threshold.

faq.q: How are duplicate form submissions handled?
faq.a: The webhook uses an idempotency header (X-Event-Id). If your form tool sends the same event ID twice, Ballet deduplicates it automatically and runs the playbook only once.

sampleOutput: Slack message: New lead from Acme Corp (sarah@acme.com). Score: 9/10. Hot lead. Reason: Enterprise company, asking about API integration, clear buying intent.
whatYouNeed: Form tool that sends HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks, Slack Bot integration connected and invited to lead alerts channel
failureHandling: If lead scoring or Slack posting fails, the run appears in history with error details. The webhook responds immediately to avoid form tool timeouts.
nativeVsTemplate: Use your form tool's native Slack integration if you only need raw form submissions posted to Slack. Use this template when you want AI-powered lead scoring, hot lead prioritization, and intelligent context so your sales team knows which leads to contact first.
setup: Connect the Slack Bot integration in Ballet once and invite the bot to your lead alerts channel.
Publish the playbook and point your form tool's webhook at the URL shown in Studio.

Submit a test form and watch the run.
